name: DuckingVR
summary:
DuckingVR is the virtual reality module of the MMDR platform, designed as a hands-on molecular simulation laboratory for universities and research institutions.

The Meta Quest app ships with preloaded demonstration experiments, ready to use immediately after installation — no additional setup required. To access experiments generated on the MMDR platform, a small companion desktop application handles login and downloads the user's experiments to the local PC.
